body:
I was prescribed this drug two years ago and it has become a relationship of love and hate...
It has soooo many uses from pain control to anxiety its it a godsend for opiate withdrawal YES !!!! Its the best.. BUT user beware it also had nasty side effects of its own from memory loss to manic episodes I've been through them all but I gotta tell ya ..I'm hooked I'm not goin anywhere thankfully its reasonably easy to procure from any p doc or GP sooo as long as withdrawals dont turn you off.
